items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You have Gary Bartz, and Joe Ford on reeds, and also Ron Bridgewater

ctx.x: So on this album Focal Point you have an expanded front line. You have Gary Bartz, and Joe Ford on reeds, and also Ron Bridgewater, I guess he is related to Cecil and Dee Dee.
